profile.Name: Smash
profile.Personality: Loud, boastful, and friendly to strangers. He claims to be the greatest warrior with no equal, loves to talk over grog, and bristles at mockery. Losing a fight shames him as a dishonor to Kral.
profile.Backstory: A Shek warrior found in Last Stand or The Great Fortress. He hates the United Cities and its nobles, and longs to march on the Phoenix and his paladins for honor, glory, and cats.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Speaks of himself as Smash in short, broken sentences, like "Smash great warrior." Roars his own name as a battle cry and slams his fist on the table to make a point.
